fields.name: kdockw
fields.summary: A lightweight dock for KDE Plasma 6 and spiritual successor to Latte Dock.
fields.description:
KDockW is a lightweight, Wayland-only dock for KDE Plasma 6 and a spiritual successor to Latte Dock. It provides parabolic hover zoom with an optional in-place zoom mode, plus PipeWire window previews for running applications.

The dock supports primary-screen, all-screens, and follow-active-screen multi-monitor modes, with per-screen settings and virtual desktop filtering. KDockW also provides notification badges, task progress indicators, grouped-window cycling, and configurable dock behavior.

KDockW integrates with Plasma through Qt 6, KDE Frameworks 6, and Kirigami. It includes keyboard navigation with AT-SPI screen reader support and is licensed under GPL-3.0-or-later.

steps: No KDockW Launchpad project or PPA is configured. The old ~isac322/~krema records belong to the original Krema project and must not be changed.
Create a separate KDockW project and PPA only with maintainer authorization.
Before the first signed upload, register the approved public signing key on the KDockW owner account and verify that the source package name is kdockw.

limitations: No KDockW Launchpad project or PPA has been created or verified.
The listed artwork is KDockW source media for a possible future project; it is not evidence of an existing publication.
The former ~isac322 and Krema records are not KDockW destinations and must remain unchanged.
